key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:071A
name: build_square_attribute_table
description: Fills a 64-entry byte table, one entry per square of an eight-by-eight grid, with a code taken from a lookup table and a flag test. Routines run before and after the loop, and the table is written in place.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0770
name: fill_square_table_remaining
description: Continues filling the 64-entry square table from the current index, computing each entry from the same lookup and flag tests, until all 64 entries are written. It then makes a final call and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0774
name: fill_square_table_from_state
description: Fills the rest of the 64-entry square table, starting from a code selected by a type check, writing each entry until the table is complete.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:079A
name: fill_square_table_alternate_codes
description: Fills the 64-entry square table using a different set of codes for each entry type, starting from a fixed initial code, until all entries are written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:07A0
name: fill_square_table_from_flags
description: Fills the 64-entry square table from the current index, choosing each entry code from the type lookup and the flag test, until all entries are written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:07B4
name: fill_square_table_with_offsets
description: Fills the 64-entry square table with codes that depend on the type lookup, the flag test and whether each square lies in the lower or upper half of its row, until every entry is written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:07BA
name: fill_square_table_flag_codes
description: Fills the 64-entry square table, choosing each starting code from the flag test and writing entries until the table is complete.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:07CE
name: fill_square_table_zero_start
description: Fills the 64-entry square table starting from a zero code, with later codes taken from the type lookup and flag tests, until all entries are written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:07E6
name: fill_square_table_from_one
description: Fills the 64-entry square table starting from an initial value of one, choosing later codes from the type lookup and flag tests.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0800
name: fill_square_table_zero_codes
description: Writes sequential entries into the 64-entry square table, starting from a zero code and taking each code from the type lookup and flag tests, until the table is full.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0820
name: build_row_bitmasks
description: For each of the eight rows of the square table, sets one bit per square whose low three bits are nonzero, deciding by a flag bit and the argument value. It writes one mask byte per row and returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0898
name: reset_pending_square_markers
description: Releases a pending entry when one is set, then sets two stored markers to 255. It returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:08D6
name: setup_bitplane_pointers_and_draw
description: Initialises display state: it saves five longwords of a record, points four bitplane pointers at offsets 8000 bytes apart, clears a flag, then draws rows in a loop through library calls at fixed spacing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0AA8
name: copy_buffer_then_process_input
description: Copies 480 bytes into a destination buffer, then runs an input loop that waits for event codes. On a select event it looks up the square at the current index and records the selection.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0ADC
name: handle_square_selection_or_move
description: Handles one board event for the square at the current index. When nothing is selected it picks up the piece stored on that square; otherwise it draws the move and stores the piece on the destination square, updating the square table. It returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0BAA
name: process_board_pointer_events
description: Runs an event loop over the board. One event code releases any current selection, and another works out the square under the pointer from its coordinates and selects it when it lies on the board, updating the stored table entries as it goes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0BD8
name: wait_for_board_select_event
description: Repeatedly waits for input events. When a square carries a piece it picks that piece up, and on a second event code it releases the selection and checks the square under the pointer for a valid board position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0C40
name: release_selection_and_pick_square
description: Releases any current selection, works out the board square under the pointer from its coordinates, and when that square is valid records it as the selection and draws the highlight. It then loops for further input.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0CA0
name: handle_screen_region_selection
description: Checks whether the pointer lies in a particular screen region and, if so, records the matching entry as the current selection and highlights it. Otherwise it continues the event loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0CD2
name: allocate_piece_slot_or_report
description: Searches a table of 32 piece entries for a free slot. If none is free it releases the current selection and reports that there are too many pieces; otherwise it records the free slot index and runs the input loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0D00
name: place_piece_from_slot
description: Records a slot index, draws the piece stored in that slot, then runs the input loop until an event ends the placement. It returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0D46
name: clear_board_and_run_input
description: Clears all 64 square entries and their row markers, then runs the input loop that handles board events until a terminating event arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0D84
name: load_board_state_then_input
description: Copies 480 bytes of saved board data into the working table, clears the current selection, and runs the input loop for board events.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0D94
name: copy_board_block_then_input
description: Copies a 480-byte block of board data into the working table byte by byte, then runs the input loop for board events. It returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0DBA
name: report_codes_until_clear
description: Repeatedly requests a status code and, while it is nonzero, clears the selection and reports that code. It then runs the board input loop. It returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0DD2
name: initialise_board_session_state
description: Resets the selection and board state fields, stores two parameter words, makes several library calls to set up the session, and clears the busy flag. It returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0E1A
name: run_board_input_loop
description: Runs the board input loop: it waits for event codes, handles selection and placement for the square under the pointer, and keeps going until the surrounding code exits.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0E1C
name: process_board_input_events
description: Processes board input events in a loop. When a select code arrives it applies the select-or-place logic to the square at the current index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0E5A
name: forward_single_argument_call
description: Passes its one argument to another routine and then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0E76
name: call_hook_then_forward
description: Calls a stored hook routine with its argument, then passes control to another routine. It returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0E92
name: map_pointer_position_to_square
description: Converts pointer coordinates into a square index by searching two threshold tables of nine entries each. Positions outside the board mark the square as invalid; when the square matches the stored one it toggles a flag and makes a call, otherwise it makes two calls and clears the stored square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:0FC6
name: reset_board_selection_and_markers
description: Releases the current selection, sets the two stored square markers to 255, copies two byte fields, and resets the selection state to empty. It returns nothing.
